releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.2 - Dynamic Headroom & Anti-Pumping DSP
releaseNotes: Studio Acoustic Refinement: Implemented automatic dynamic headroom compensation to eliminate wideband vocal pumping and breathing on heavy kick hits. Coupled stereo envelope limiter with 180ms release and C1-continuous soft-knee saturation to eliminate sub-bass flat-topping odd harmonics. Full native routing for Volume Boost.
